title: HostResolved
description: Params of the host.resolved RPC (nocx-uo1k6, design D3): the client answers one host.request with a closed outcome. ok means the effect was performed — for a picker it carries the chosen absolute path in path; cancelled means the person dismissed a picker, which is an outcome and not a failure; failed carries why the client could not perform the effect, so the coordinator answers its caller honestly instead of hanging. requestId is the broker-minted id from the request, echoed back.

outcome.description: The closed outcome of the asked-for effect.

path.description: ok, for a picker only: the chosen ABSOLUTE path.

error.description: failed only: why the client could not perform the effect.
